weekly_theme.summary: 太陽剛進入獅子座不久，生活重心可能悄悄轉往獅子座相關的主題與氣氛。

aries.horoscope: 牡羊座，今天對你來說擁有巨大的潛力。您可能會注意到自己在生活的各個方面都走向極端，尤其是在心靈問題上。某一時刻你可能會全力投入，下一刻你可能會徹底退卻。在這種情緒過山車中尋求平衡非常重要。
aries.horoscope_en: Aries, today holds immense potential for you. You might notice yourself swinging to extremes in various aspects of your life, particularly in matters of the heart. One moment, you could be fully invested, and the next, you might retreat entirely. It's important to seek equilibrium in this emotional rollercoaster.

taurus.horoscope_en: Today, Taurus, you might find yourself puzzled by the commotion surrounding you. It feels like there's a blaze of activity, and you could be left wondering what drives the behavior of those around you. Instead of getting caught up in trying to decipher it all, consider letting things unfold naturally. Take a cue from those around you; perhaps it's time to inject some excitement into your life to liven things up!

gemini.horoscope_en: Today, Gemini, it's time to dust off that broom and clear out the emotional clutter in your life. Harness the powerful transformative energy surrounding you to bid farewell to those stale relationships that have been dragging you down. Embrace the spark of new beginnings and make a conscious effort to cultivate fresh habits, ensuring that old patterns don’t resurface.

cancer.horoscope_en: Today, Cancer, you might find yourself brimming with energy, yet uncertain about how to channel it effectively. Why not get moving and engage in some physical activity? Allow your body to experience the invigorating rush of a good workout. Reconnect with the feeling of exertion; it will uplift your spirits and motivate you to maintain a healthier lifestyle as you challenge your physical limits.

leo.horoscope_en: Today, Leo, let your heart's warmth radiate! There's a vibrant passion within you that yearns for expression. Embrace your romantic side and let your creativity flourish. Take charge in your relationships, showing your loved ones how much they mean to you. Gather your courage and step into a leadership role, but remember to be affectionate without overwhelming them. Allow space for others to thrive!

virgo.horoscope_en: Today, Virgo, you may find that discussions around love could become a bit heated. While your intuition may be nudging you to take a step back, the energy around you might be pushing you to explore new possibilities. It's important to acknowledge that your heart craves some space and independence. Be mindful that your empathetic disposition might lead you to overanalyze the current situation.

libra.horoscope_en: Libra, think about embarking on a journey with someone special. A getaway from your everyday routine could be the perfect way to reignite the spark of romance in your life. If you're single, an adventure abroad might just lead you to your soulmate. Open your mind to new experiences and embrace fresh perspectives.

scorpio.horoscope_en: Scorpio, today is the perfect opportunity for you to actively seek out love. Instead of staying home and feeling sorry for yourself, embrace your adventurous side and make the first move. Remember, you hold the power to lift yourself out of any slump, so take action! Your romantic desires are fueled by intense passion right now, so be mindful of where you direct your affections.

Consider hosting a gathering or inviting a few close friends for a cozy dinner. A vibrant passion ignites your romantic and social spirit. Your creative energy is at its highest this month, and you'll notice that your interactions with others are exceptionally harmonious.

capricorn.horoscope_en: Today, Capricorn, you may find it necessary to make some tweaks in your approach to foster better connections with those around you. If you're seeking attention in love and romance, consider embracing a bolder and more assertive stance. Don't hesitate to aim high; playing it safe and staying in the background is unlikely to yield results. Step up, be courageous, and take some risks!

Embrace the idea of partnership in its many forms, as you explore various commitments with different individuals. Remember, it takes a spectrum of colors to create a full rainbow.

pisces.horoscope_en: Embrace your bold side in matters of the heart, Pisces. A tiny spark could be just what you need to reignite a fading passion. Your partner might hold the key to the insights you’re looking for.
